job.title: Advisor- Cyber Security
job.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW:
Responsible for ensuring consistent enterprise security, collaborating to fortify security infrastructure, reviewing security policy changes, developing and implementing solutions to mitigate risks, leading incident response, managing technical documentation, researching security threats, and proactively monitoring security infrastructure.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
  • Ensure consistent state across the enterprise by supporting business and Service Provider activities encompassing endpoint security, network security, perimeter security, and data security.
  • Lead close collaboration with business and Service Provider representatives to provide both preventative and proactive support, thereby fortifying the security infrastructure.
  • Review requested security policy changes to in-scope security infrastructure, provide recommendations to management for approval and implementation using internal job aids.
  • Develop and implement enterprise security solutions to mitigate information systems risks and vulnerabilities, configuring and analyzing security tools and software.
  • Manage and review technical and operational documentation of in-scope security systems to ensure knowledge transfer and continuity.
  • Research attempted or successful efforts to compromise systems security and designs countermeasures.
  • Assess and monitor in-scope security infrastructure and respond to operational alerts from the monitoring system, proactively identifying potential security issues.
  • Lead incident response activities as needed, assisting in the prompt resolution and mitigation of security incidents.
  • Comply with all applicable laws/regulations, as well as company policies/procedures
  • Perform other duties as required

Disclaimer: This job description is general in nature and is not designed to contain or to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, essential functions and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.
QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, information systems or related field.
  • Five (5) years of experience in information technology or Network Security, Identity and access management.
  • Knowledge of hardware, software, and network.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Knowledge of IDaas, PAM, IGA, RKI and directory services AD, OUD, and EntralID preferred.
  • Knowledge of endpoint detection and response, network intrusion detection/prevention, firewall administration, and IT lifecycle management, preferred.
  • Ability to communicate technical subject matter effectively to multiple organizational layers
JOB CONDITIONS:
  • Some travel required

job.title: Technical Architect
job.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW:
Provides enterprise-level architectural leadership across compute, storage, network, cloud, and application platforms. Responsible for developing architecture blueprints, reference designs, standards, and patterns that guide engineering and operational teams.
ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:
1.    Develop and maintain architecture blueprints, reference architectures, design standards, and platform patterns to ensure consistency and scalability across enterprise systems.
2.    Translate business requirements into technical architecture, ensuring alignment with strategy, security controls, operational readiness, and lifecycle plans.
3.    Lead end-to-end solution design for infrastructure, platforms, data center technologies, and mission-critical systems.
4.    Conduct architectural assessments, gap analyses, and technology evaluations to recommend improvements and modernization opportunities.
5.    Collaborate with engineering, operations, and product teams to ensure solutions are designed for resiliency, performance, efficiency, and supportability.
6.    Provide architectural governance and oversight during solution development, implementation, and transition to operations.
7.    Create detailed design documents, diagrams, and technical specifications supporting platform engineering and implementation work.
8.    Establish technology standards, best practices, and guardrails to ensure secure and compliant deployments across platforms.
9.    Evaluate new technologies, tools, platforms, and vendors, providing guidance on adoption strategies and long-term roadmap impacts.
10.    Support capacity planning, performance engineering, and reliability engineering efforts to ensure architecture scalability and sustainability.
11.    Participate in incident and problem management by contributing root cause analysis and architectural recommendations to prevent recurrence.
12.    Lead architecture reviews, design sessions, and technical workshops with stakeholders across IT and business units.
13.    Guide automation, orchestration, and infrastructure-as-code integration throughout architecture designs and engineering processes.
14.    Contribute to disaster recovery, redundancy, and continuity strategies, ensuring architectural alignment with enterprise resilience goals.
15.    Comply with all applicable laws/regulations, as well as company policies/procedures.
16.    Perform other duties as assigned. 
Disclaimer: This job description is general in nature and is not designed to contain or to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.
